motivation: Measured v2 failure: residual DDPM produced severe false extremes across the original held-out Ida benchmark and frozen cross-event robustness folds.

sampling_changes.sampler: deterministic DDIM eta=0 update using predicted epsilon and reconstructed clean residual
sampling_changes.clean_residual_clip: symmetric per-channel clip in normalized residual space using training-only absolute residual q99.5

training_changes: none; same epsilon-prediction objective and validation-only checkpoint selection
evaluation: same four frozen cross-event folds and same metrics as STAGE2_CROSS_EVENT_PROTOCOL_v1
success_gate: v3 diffusion must avoid catastrophic false extremes and materially reduce diffusion-v2 MAE/tail/PSD errors without test-event tuning; superiority over deterministic is not assumed or required
claim_boundary: Exploratory safety correction evaluated on previously available storms; not a new pristine independent holdout and not operational NEPS-G skill.
